title: Ten Days and a Cup of Water
old_p1: Daniel and his three friends were taken far from home to Babylon, a big city with a powerful king. The king sent them rich food from his own table.
But Heavenly Father had taught His people which foods to eat, and Daniel wanted to obey. “Please,” he asked kindly, “give us vegetables and water for ten days. Then look at us and see.”
old_p2: For ten days they ate vegetables and drank water. When the days were over, their faces looked healthier than all the other young men’s.
Heavenly Father gave the four friends knowledge and wisdom. The king found them ten times better than all his wise men.
Small, quiet choices make a heart strong. Think of one good choice you made today, and feel how strong and good it made you inside.
p1: Daniel and his three friends were taken far from home to Babylon. Babylon was a new and strange place.
Every day the king of Babylon sent them his rich food and drink. But Daniel wanted to keep Heavenly Father’s rules about food. So he did not want the king’s food.
Daniel asked kindly, “Please give us vegetables to eat and water to drink. Try it for ten days. Then look at us and see.”
p2: For ten days, the four friends ate vegetables and drank water. They looked healthier and stronger than the other young men! Heavenly Father helped them learn and grow wise.
Daniel made a good choice far from home, and he asked kindly. You can make good choices too, even when others do not. Tonight, think of one good choice you made today.
